title: SUCCESSOR Ω: Build the Next Discovery Lab — public integration checklist
body:
Build one connected bounded synthetic discovery lab across Alpha, Manager, Jobs and Fleet under the supplied2026-10-21 specification. No credential/security-setting changes, spending or wallet actions.

Integration lead: Codex root. Work owners cover Alpha runtime/checkers, Alpha UI/history, currency receiver seams and Fleet admission, with separate same-session research and source reviewers. These are work roles, not maintainer or organizational independence claims.

| Repository | Public work | Current scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Alpha | #4851 | Six constructors, finite checks, strict artifacts, existing-history v2 extension, UI and source-qualified evidence |
| Manager | [#1613](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobManager/pull/1613) | Alternative USDC6 zero-cap local inspection; native release integration pending |
| Jobs | [#4010](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobsv0/pull/4010) | Alternative AGIALPHA18 inspection; preserve publisher/telemetry baselines |
| Fleet | [#64](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Fleet-Linux/pull/64) | Finite task admission and separately scoped semantic review; external execution unprovisioned |

Current Alpha candidate `0c0bbcd4b7be6f30c3ad11159cb55a4c9ff30908`, tree `21393e953255665e372f831fda37cb2e176709c7`, sourceHash `3cc770caddaa916974a5836b77e7d76ebdd022025948f3bfd52c4b9b9174dc3b`. All11 changed public raw blobs/modes/sizes and the fetched tree match the reviewed freeze. Local228/228 Node tests,15/15 focused Python tests and all applicable hooks pass. Nineteen new regressions reproduce the old artifact/charter/result/parent/source frame failures; seven extra independent probes and exact26-source/three-worker regeneration pass. The artifact P1 is implemented with one owned frame, preserving original WeakMap identities and using the same captured bytes for semantic work. Fresh complete immutable0c browser acceptance passes12/12 with four campaigns/eight actual downloads. Exact0c configured review completed with a workspace-frame P1 and startPayload source-frame P2; the scoped repair/compatibility tests are in progress. Native repins and new evidence publication remain held until the corrected exact source clears review.

Current native heads Manager68d1d3ca, Jobs28503483 and Fleet0dd352fd still pin0385/common98. Their scoped local tests and unchanged raw drafts pass; currency report snapshots pass56 tests/route plus10 independent probes. [Original0385 browser dataset](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/tree/598338fdc2542087877981f750a23359501d9e08/evidence/discovery-lab-0385) retains its10 untouched JSONs plus metadata with all12 public raw identities verified. That dataset predates the artifact/charter/result frame correction and does not qualify current0c API boundaries.

- [x] Read the actual seven papers/available companions and publish specification, source map and ownership.
- [x] Connected deterministic campaign, independent finite checks, failures/ties/cheaper alternatives and stronger successor.
- [x] Backward-compatible existing workspace/history extension, resource reservations, interruption/CAS recovery.
- [ ] Fresh final-source browser/native/archive qualification and configured hosted review/CI.
- [ ] Qualified predecessor integrations and versioned complete release profiles.
- [ ] Final qualified merges/releases, downloaded asset checks and live served-byte acceptance.

[Historical1665 evidence](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/tree/84d6fd174e875f1060d1c96866b3b3d7465fc425/evidence/discovery-lab-1665) and [daa8 browser evidence](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/tree/df3381f2ad1212a1ee3de6f1c342dc16eb231eb9/evidence/discovery-lab-daa8) retain their exact original scope, raw downloads and limitations. Both complete browser journeys passed12 checks on their own source; neither qualifies current0c or public HTTPS. The full1665 offline Python outcome remains failed3543passed/2notebook EPERM failures/65skipped/4xfailed,81.31% coverage. No failure or skip is relabeled.

Sequence:
- Alpha PDF repair#4849 is already merged/deployed and preserved. Owner#4848 now79f5a0cc includes catalog propagation. Residual#4852 normally integrates owner79 and adds a stale-plan guard;583 tests/hooks/implementation typing pass locally, configured current5a94c17 code review is complete with no findings; full hosted fallback checks are pending. Preserve its1.37.1 release and all runtime/publication gates before Discovery's seven-overlap integration.
- Manager maintenance[#1615](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobManager/pull/1615) merged normally at900bb4b4; all eight fresh main workflows pass, including all four CI shards. Actual M Prep artifact12388736170 and all1,624 manifest entries/1,613 source Git blobs are independently verified.1.19.6 publication remains pending. Redundant#1614 is closed superseded. Publishedv1.19.5 already contains the TI baseline from stale open#1607.
- Preserve Jobs#4007's rc17 and #4008's current toolchain/raw scanner evidence and genuine review obligations. Genuine58eb push originals are available and pass existing strict tool/query/reference/result gates; PR-merge623 archives remain separate. Current owner792 installation/source metadata validation passes with productionApproved:false. Final-main/service/fullCI/release acceptance is still separate; no old review is transferred.
- Fleet#61 is a separate held custody lane. Ordinary#64 does not provision installed or external execution.

Current state: public implementation candidates and local qualification; Discovery is not merged, released or live-deployed. Existing owner histories remain authoritative. Recheck all main/owner refs before integration; preserve required checks and honest outcomes.

Manager maintenance main900bb4b4 is ready for the existing guarded1.19.6 publisher step: exact-main workflows, actual candidate archive and all source blobs are verified; tag1.19.6 is absent. Dispatch, final collector/managed attestations, publication and live verification have not occurred. Existing publisher gates remain intact. Discovery itself is not released.
